McpServerDefinition.description: Revenue Cloud quoting for Claude: catalog ping, prospect, create/reuse Draft, find quotes, approve/reject, ramp create, order, amend, renew/cancel, unsent reply.

tools.descriptionOverride: Returns quoting MCP skill version and tool names. Call after reconnect or when a parameter is unknown. If missing, reconnect MCP and re-upload the skill.

Creates Draft quotes under one Opportunity. Places the first option of each product mix, then Deep Clones siblings and patches term/discount. Returns remainingOptionsJson only if CPU forces a pause. Then render comparisonDisplay as a visual card.
Creates a Draft, or reuses the Draft on the same Opportunity and quote name. Pass opportunityName. Do not create a second quote for the same email. linesJson adds every product.
Creates or reuses Account and Contact. Optional billing address or useDemoAddress after confirm. Then createRevenueCloudQuote. Never SObject-insert Account.
Adds products to an existing Draft. Pass linesJson ([{product, quantity}]) for every new SKU in this call. Do not add-product per SKU when linesJson is set.
Applies a percent discount to all lines or to lines matching a product name on a Revenue Cloud quote.
Patches quantity, termMonths, startDate (yyyy-mm-dd), and/or discount on an existing Draft in one Place Sales Transaction. 5 years = 60. Never rebuild or SObject-update Quote.
Read-only recap of quote lines: product, quantity, and prices. Use after create or add.
Lists Draft quotes. Pass opportunityName after reconnect to pin the deal. One match returns latestQuoteId. Do not create a quote.
Submits a Draft Revenue Cloud quote for approval by quote name, account name, or Quote Id. Ask the user to pick when more than one quote matches. Only quotes with lines can be submitted.
Approves or rejects the assigned ApprovalWorkItem. Decision approve or reject. Caller must be an assignee. Never PATCH Quote.Status.

Loads configurator option groups, current picks, attributes, and constraint messages for a bundle on a Draft quote. Does not save. Ask the user about unanswered groups, then call configureRevenueCloudBundle. Never insert child QuoteLineItem rows.
Applies named bundle options and attributes, then saves through the Revenue Cloud configurator. Call describe first. Pass product names or SKUs, not child QuoteLineItem inserts.

Creates a Revenue Cloud Order from a quote via createOrdersFromQuote. Resolve by quote name, account name, or Quote Id. Then call activateRevenueCloudOrder so assets are created. Never insert Order rows yourself.

Activates a Draft Revenue Cloud Order so Salesforce creates assets. Stamps Bill to Contact and addresses when missing. If isPartial, call again with the same order Id until assets appear. Never insert Asset rows yourself.

Starts an asset amendment via initiateAmendment. quantityChange is a delta. startDate yyyy-mm-dd required. Pass opportunityName. Bundle component: amend parent qty 0 then patch child. Then order+activate. Never PATCH Asset.

Explains list price, quote discount, proration, and amount due. Uses QuoteLineDetail slices and the persisted pricing waterfall. Blank Net Unit Price on an amendment line is expected — do not treat it as a failure. Resolve by quote name, number, account, or Quote Id. Pass productName to focus on one product.

Read-only recap of what an account owns: current AssetStatePeriod MRR and Discount, derived ARR (MRR×12), and add-ons. Never Asset.CurrentMrr. Quote line Discount is a draft quote, not installed base.
Compares a Draft quote to current AssetStatePeriod qty and Discount. Quote 30% off is not what they own. Never use Asset.CurrentMrr.
Read-only deal stage: Draft, approval, order, assets. Do not submit, create an order, or activate from this tool.
Starts a renewal or cancellation Quote. action=renew or cancel. Confirm cancel first. startDate yyyy-mm-dd required for cancel. Pass opportunityName. Then order+activate. Never PATCH Asset.
Drafts an unsent customer email. If Gmail has a draft/create tool, put subject and bodyDisplay there. Never send_message. Leave unsent.
Describes ramp segments, creates the first yearly schedule from segmentsJson, or patches qty on existing groups. Never SObject-insert QuoteLineGroup. Never rebuild the quote.
Read-only next BillingSchedule date, quote TCV (GrandTotal), and UsageSummary. TCV is not ARR. Never Asset.CurrentMrr.

Generates the Quote Proposal PDF (RLM_QuoteProposal). Reuses the last PDF when the quote is unchanged. If isPartial, immediately call again with quoteId and documentGenerationProcessId; do not reply to the user. Never insert ContentVersion rows yourself.
